rules.score: Finite numeric for evaluated, empty otherwise; missing never means negative
rules.percentile_rank: Declared percentile semantics, percent units, lower_is_better and [0,100]
rules.mhc_key: Empty for peptide; exact canonical full presenter for peptide_hla
rules.task: Frozen native vocabulary or external: namespace; TCR-specific scope rejected
rules.source_row: Nonempty original source row/reference; candidate IDs not required
rules.versions: predictor_version/model_version may be empty when unknown
rules.duplicates: Reject all duplicate logical keys, including identical duplicates
rules.channels: Scope, kind, semantics, units and direction constant within provider/model/run/task/metric
